edb: SELECT indicator_code AS field, observation_date::text AS observation_date, published_date::text AS published_date, value::float8 AS value FROM public.edb WHERE indicator_code = ANY($1::text[]) AND observation_date < $2::date AND COALESCE(published_date, observation_date) < $2::date ORDER BY observation_date, indicator_code
quant: SELECT field, observation_date::text AS observation_date, published_date::text AS published_date, to_jsonb(numeric_value::float8) AS value FROM public.quant_input WHERE field=ANY($1::text[]) AND observation_date < $2::date AND (published_date IS NULL OR published_date < $2::date) ORDER BY observation_date, field
industry_curve: SELECT observation_date::text AS observation_date, yield_pct::float8 AS yield_pct FROM public.bond_industry_curve WHERE curve_code=$1 AND tenor_years=3 AND observation_date<$2::date ORDER BY observation_date
issuer_daily:
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t),'[]'::json)::text AS payload FROM (
SELECT h.valuation_date::text AS date, h.valuation_date::text AS observation_date,
i.issuer_name AS issuer, i.bond_type, coalesce(i.placement_type,'未知') AS placement_type,
CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny IS NULL OR (h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND (h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NULL OR h.remaining_term_years IS NULL)))=0
THEN sum(h.chinabond_yield_pct*h.outstanding_balance_cny) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0)/nullif(sum(h.outstanding_balance_cny) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0),0) END AS yield_percent,
CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny IS NULL OR (h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND (h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NULL OR h.remaining_term_years IS NULL)))=0
THEN sum(h.remaining_term_years*h.outstanding_balance_cny) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0)/nullif(sum(h.outstanding_balance_cny) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0),0) END AS tenor_years,
regr_slope(h.chinabond_yield_pct,h.remaining_term_years) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NOT NULL AND h.remaining_term_years IS NOT NULL) AS yield_slope,
regr_intercept(h.chinabond_yield_pct,h.remaining_term_years) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NOT NULL AND h.remaining_term_years IS NOT NULL) AS yield_intercept,
min(h.remaining_term_years) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NOT NULL AND h.remaining_term_years IS NOT NULL) AS min_tenor,
max(h.remaining_term_years) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NOT NULL AND h.remaining_term_years IS NOT NULL) AS max_tenor,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NOT NULL AND h.remaining_term_years IS NOT NULL) AS fit_observations,
coalesce(sum(h.outstanding_balance_cny) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0),0) AS balance_cny,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny>0) AS observations,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.outstanding_balance_cny IS NULL OR (h.outstanding_balance_cny>0 AND (h.chinabond_yield_pct IS NULL OR h.remaining_term_years IS NULL))) AS missing_observations
FROM public.bond_history h JOIN public.bond_issuance i ON h.bond_code=public.exchange_bond_code(i.bond_code)
WHERE h.valuation_date<$1::date AND h.valuation_date >= $2::date AND i.interest_rate_type='固息' AND i.bond_code ~ '\.(SH|SZ)$'
GROUP BY h.valuation_date,i.issuer_name,i.bond_type,i.placement_type ORDER BY h.valuation_date,i.issuer_name,i.bond_type,i.placement_type) t

issue: SELECT v.field,i.issue_date::text AS observation_date,NULL::text AS published_date,i.bond_code AS entity_key,v.value FROM public.bond_issuance i CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('ISSUER_NAME',to_jsonb(i.issuer_name)),('ISSUER_RATING',to_jsonb(i.issuer_rating)),('BOND_EXPIRE_YEAR',to_jsonb(i.original_tenor_years)),('ISSUERATE_REFERENCE',to_jsonb(i.coupon_reference_pct)),('ACTUAL_ISSUE_SCALE',to_jsonb(i.issue_amount_100m)),('BOND_TYPE',to_jsonb(i.bond_type)),('IS_OEB',to_jsonb(CASE WHEN i.has_option THEN '是' WHEN i.has_option=false THEN '否' END)),('ISSUECREDITSPREAD',to_jsonb(i.issue_spread_bp)),('PI_RATE_TYPE',to_jsonb(i.interest_rate_type)),('TENDERDATE',to_jsonb(i.tender_date::text)),('TENDERFINALCOUPON',to_jsonb(i.final_coupon_pct)),('ISSCORPCREDITRAT',to_jsonb(i.issuance_rating)),('TENDERANNCDATE',to_jsonb(i.tender_announcement_date::text))) v(field,value) WHERE i.issue_date < $1::date AND v.value IS NOT NULL AND v.value<>'null'::jsonb ORDER BY i.issue_date,i.bond_code,v.field
